claims.summary: Title-slide context uses the lesson concept phrase instead of courseName: phrase, preventing Course: Topic echoes from visible title slides.
Numbered assessment echoes such as Assessment: 1. Assessment are de-duplicated before becoming slide artifacts.
Title-slide speaker-note anchors strip long course-name prefixes before quoted Use guidance.
An Environmental Justice / Policy memo regression pins exported slide text, visual descriptions, visual plans, and speaker notes.
